evidence_basis.read_method: git cat-file / ls-tree / rev-parse / for-each-ref against a caller-pinned commit id in a local object store
evidence_basis.narrative_exclusion_note: Only MANIFEST.json documents and the payload blobs they claim were read. Pack prose (README.md, BOUNDARIES.md, LAUNCH.md) was never parsed for claims, and MANIFEST_ALL.json prose fields such as evidence_status were not treated as evidence.

targets.refusal_reason: The commit carries no path under the requested pack root, so there is no claim to check. The reproducer raises rather than reporting a vacuously clean corpus.

findings.falsified_claim: files[] includes _spine.py as a member of the pack directory
findings.observed: The claimed path is absent from all five pack directories at this commit. Bytes with the claimed digest are present exactly once, at packs/_shared/_spine.py.
findings.process_boundary_effect: Packs 06-10 import _spine as a sibling module. A consumer that materialises exactly what each per-pack manifest enumerates gets no sibling _spine.py, so the pack cannot be imported without an out-of-manifest copy step.
findings.narrative_status: packs/MANIFEST_ALL.json prose describes the collapse and the required restore step, but the per-pack manifests were not updated to match; the reproducer detects the gap from bytes alone and does not rely on that prose.

findings.observed: Both claimed files are absent from the pack directory, and a whole-commit content-addressed search for their claimed digests returns no match. This is content loss at this commit, not relocation.
findings.process_boundary_effect: Pack 07 cannot be qualified at this commit: its own test file is one of the missing members, so the pack carries a manifest asserting a test suite that is not published.
findings.digest_provenance: Both claimed digests and byte counts were read from the immutable manifest blob at modules/operators/07-capability-manufacture/MANIFEST.json at this commit; the absence search hashed every blob in the commit and matched neither.

findings.falsified_claim: $.root identifies the corpus the manifest describes
findings.expected: a repository-relative pack root such as packs
findings.process_boundary_effect: The published aggregate manifest records the build host's temporary directory as the corpus root. Any consumer that resolves paths from $.root fails outside that one build host, and the value also leaks build-host layout into a published artefact.

findings.falsified_claim: $.packs enumerates the packs present under the pack root
findings.observed: The aggregate manifest covers five of twelve directories under packs/. Five are published packs 06-10 that it does not mention; _shared and obzio_spine are support directories rather than packs and are listed here only because the reproducer enumerates directories, not pack semantics.
findings.process_boundary_effect: A consumer that enumerates the corpus from packs/MANIFEST.json sees five packs and silently omits packs 06-10, whose claims live in a second manifest with a different dialect.
findings.false_positive_risk: The _shared and obzio_spine entries are support directories; the gap that matters is packs 06-10. Recorded openly rather than filtered, because filtering by name would embed a guess about pack semantics into the checker.

positive_evidence.claim: 67 of 72 per-pack file claims at commit 1e6f53c323f8326d12af213557082a3665991f19 verify exactly on digest and byte count.
positive_evidence.significance: The corpus is largely checkable from immutable objects alone; the discrepancies are localised, not systemic.

positive_evidence.claim: 12 of 14 per-pack file claims at commit 96adfe7d79257389318af10ee9c9e3a0c2138590 verify exactly, including the _spine.py claim that fails at the other commit.
positive_evidence.significance: The same claim is satisfiable at a different immutable commit, which is how F-WA-006-01 is shown to be a publication-path defect rather than content loss.

positive_evidence.claim: Ref and HEAD digests are identical before and after every scan, and no checkout, fetch, ref write or index write occurs.
positive_evidence.significance: The check is performed without branch mutation, which is the second half of the hypothesis.

out_of_scope_manifests.reason: It is an aggregate in a third dialect whose files map is keyed by repository-root-relative paths, including paths under a packs2/ prefix that does not exist at this commit. Checking it correctly needs dialect support this reproducer version does not have.
out_of_scope_manifests.guard: The reproducer only reads files named exactly MANIFEST.json, so this document is skipped rather than mis-parsed into invented findings.
